description.p: Infiltrator Software provides one coherent surface for discovering, installing, updating and repairing software while keeping package-system mechanics isolated behind replaceable backend contracts.

The Linux implementation merges verified Infiltrator catalogue records, host AppStream applications and configured Flatpak metadata while presenting Discover, Installed, Updates, System, Repositories, History and Repair in one application.

Reduces app-shell coupling by centralising cross-page coordination, moving System and Repair data work behind dedicated boundaries, and separating transaction-review and runtime-state responsibilities from page views.

Repairs release metadata and Debian changelog integrity, removes committed tool-output artefacts, and adds CI guards that keep release identities aligned without changing the 0.3.69 runtime architecture.

Reduces app-shell coupling by moving shared domain records into the core model, making installed package state engine-owned, and extracting update reconciliation, external discovery and transaction planning into a dedicated Updates controller.
Aligns the Details action with the update-row title badges while keeping version and repository metadata on the compact secondary line.
Restores a compact Updates hierarchy with aligned semantic badges, list-local selection controls and flatter update rows without changing the colour palette.
Enforces the canonical three-face MB Corpo typography contract and removes synthetic condensed-bold rendering from Software UI roles.
Lazily constructs inactive pages, scopes update refresh timing to the Updates page and aligns page transitions with the current InfiltratorOS shell cadence.
Removes the remaining two-second tray poll, switches runtime changes to event-driven monitors, and aligns shell geometry with current InfiltratorOS/Common metrics.
Eliminates redundant tray polling I/O and final decorative shell residue while aligning Software with System Settings 0.4.52 and Common 1.19.38.
Moves Discover indexing off the GTK thread, avoids redundant global theme restyling, converges shell geometry and card surfaces with current System Settings, and updates to Common 1.19.38.
Removes final compatibility-planner UI residue, aligns the shell with the current InfiltratorOS standard and verifies the latest Common 1.19.36 integration.

Completes the native-path performance cleanup by removing the retired GUI APT backend, avoiding duplicate Flatpak/Cinnamon refresh work, isolating the lightweight installed-state fallback and deleting obsolete Discover Spotlight UI state.
Fixes Linux kernel-manager timeouts by indexing package candidates once and giving computed kernel inventory a realistic bounded D-Bus response window.
Prevents false native update-planning timeouts on slower hosts and safely recovers exact Flatpak commit identities when remote-ls returns incomplete metadata.
Restores lazy page hydration and avoids restarting the resident tray on every launch, reducing startup CPU and duplicate package-state work.
Replaces stale resident update-indicator processes after Software upgrades and makes the tray re-exec itself automatically when dpkg installs a newer tray binary.
Hardens native package planning around held and protected packages, architecture-qualified repository state, dependency backtracking and release-upgrade recovery.
Hardens repository trust and exact reviewed payload verification, completes interrupted-upgrade and dependency-conflict recovery, and moves repository refresh ownership into a dedicated controller.
Fixes search text being replaced one character at a time by removing recursive search synchronization and repeated navigation focus churn, while broadening Discover metadata matching.
Fixes Conflicts+Replaces planning as an explicit reviewed removal and provides a bootstrap-safe upgrade path from Software 0.3.49 before removing Mint Update Manager.

Completes Linux Mint Update Manager replacement parity with native exact Cinnamon and Nemo updates, visible external-update progress, tray/history integration and package-level mintupdate replacement semantics.
Fixes the Repositories navigation and page accents becoming nearly black under dark/system themes by using the readable information accent and full symbolic-icon opacity.

Keeps update installation visibly active on the Updates page with animated elapsed progress through privileged execution and final verification, while retaining the live durable transaction History view.

Fixes update-row icons that could render nearly black under Mint dark themes by switching application updates to a reliably symbolic refresh glyph and explicitly applying the Software operation colour.

Adds visible elapsed install activity and final-state verification, and replaces the History placeholder with a durable SQLite-backed transaction view containing exact outcomes, package version changes and provenance.

Replaces the System placeholder with live kernel, driver and core operating-system inventory, current/update state, system-critical counts, refresh controls and a hand-off to the unified Updates workflow.

Makes update recommendations understandable by displaying each preferred candidate's repository origin, active policy owner, resolved priority and selection rationale, and matches APT phased-update eligibility so staged Ubuntu updates are not recommended before the host is eligible.

Separates Debian package mechanics from distribution policy through an ordered policy-provider layer, retaining current host compatibility while creating a safe path for package-by-package migration to Infiltrator OS policy.

Corrects false update counts by honoring native APT preference and repository pin priorities, including Linux Mint's higher-priority upstream layer, and reports the exact pinned Common version in the sidebar.
Restores readable Enabled and Disabled text on interactive repository state buttons in dark/system themes by explicitly styling the GtkButton child labels and hover states.

Ensures an in-session package upgrade cannot keep an older native engine implementation alive merely because its D-Bus API version is unchanged; clients now match the exact engine package version and recycle stale same-user services automatically.

Fixes native repository signature verification for APT Signed-By ASCII-armored keyrings, including Docker's recommended docker.asc configuration, while preserving strict signature and Release integrity checks.

Makes the Repositories Enabled/Disabled state interactive for configured APT sources and Flatpak remotes, with exact source targeting, authenticated atomic APT edits, and immediate refresh of dependent software state.
Repairs package-list refresh after in-session upgrades by versioning the D-Bus engine API and replacing stale pre-v2 session engines before the newer refresh method is used.
Consolidates exact repository writes onto Common 1.19.24 and corrects asynchronous central APT release verification without changing the 0.3.11 approved-transaction safety boundary.

Hardens approved package transactions by re-simulating them after the privileged metadata refresh, rejecting any dependency, architecture, removal or version drift before mutation, and updates the shared Common foundation to 1.19.24.

Enables planned installation from Discover, displays the complete dependency transaction before authorization, and executes the exact approved package versions through the constrained privileged helper.
Removes systemic interface stalls by virtualizing Discover cards, bulk-updating Installed, shortening failed engine reads and moving repository inventory off the GTK thread.
Loads cached update state immediately, then refreshes repository metadata automatically in the background so newly published releases become visible without a manual refresh.
Makes cached Discover paint immediately and performs package-engine installed-state and icon enrichment only after the catalogue is visible.
Migrates Software and the panel updater toward one shared D-Bus package-engine generation, including engine-first inventory, native planning and event-driven tray updates.
Makes navigation atomic and paints Discover before starting its lazy catalogue refresh, preventing mixed History/Discover transition frames.
Moves package-list refresh into an isolated per-user cache and keeps administrator authorization at the actual package-mutation boundary.
Unifies the running window, About dialog, Cinnamon taskbar and Software Manager on the canonical project-owned application icon.
Operational APT updates with preflight transaction planning, constrained Polkit execution and a Mint-native XApp panel status indicator.
Fixes AppStream ownership in the merged Discover catalogue while retaining integrated APT and Flatpak source discovery.
Separates native AppStream and Flatpak catalogue ingestion for a stable unified Discover view.
Unified Infiltrator, AppStream and Flatpak discovery with live repository inventory and integrated source addition.
Fixes the Discover startup model-lifetime crash and adds a permanent graphical launch smoke test.
Discover now renders catalogue metadata immediately and hydrates verified icons asynchronously.
Real Discover catalogue with verified repository metadata, search, categories, icon caching and application details.
Common 1.19.10 semantic palette, InfiltratorFS typography scale and corrected title-bar contrast.
InfiltratorFS-aligned native shell with integrated Common theme controls and refined application chrome.
Initial read-only foundation with Common 1.19.8 theming, APT inventory and verified Debian packaging.
